[[Torkil Mux/Legends|Torkil Mux]] owned a '''HWK-290 light freighter''', which he used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shinbone]] to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[gem]]s.

==Characteristics==
From the outside, it appeared to be a stock [[HWK-290 light freighter/Legends|HWK-290 light freighter]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Adventures" />

==History==
The [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Torkil Mux/Legends|Torkil Mux]] used his HWK-290.<ref name="MostWanted">{{FFGXW|set=Most Wanted Expansion Pack|cardname=Torkil Mux}}</ref> He was skimming [[gem]]s from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal enterprises]] and storing them on a transport until he could escape the giant slug's clutches. For his [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation, he used a number of [[Unidentified walking plant species|walking plants]] as [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] labor. When the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] pair of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] arrived with more laborers, the two smugglers became concerned with their plight. When it was discovered Mux was hoarding gems, the two smugglers hatched a plan to steal the gems and free the walking plants.<ref name="Adventures" />

Chewbacca gathered the walking plants unto Mux's ship while Solo distracted the Arcona. Chewbacca took off with the transport and Solo ran back to the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] after blasting Mux's [[K4 security droid]]. The two ships docked in orbit, and Chewbacca suggested to the walking plants that they take the ship to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The pair took 60 kilograms of gems to give to Jabba and went on their separate way.<ref name="Adventures" />

==Behind the scenes==
Torkil Mux's transport appears in [[Ryder Windham]]'s [[2010]] young reader novel ''[[Adventures in Hyperspace: Shinbone Showdown]]''.<ref name="Adventures" />
